shared_elements: schematic human-like figure with raised/outstretched arms
repeated row of short vertical strokes (comb- or tooth-like band)
multiple figures scattered over a rough natural stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry a scatter of small schematic figures — including a frontal human with raised arms, profile quadrupeds and a band of repeated short vertical strokes above a curved line — set on unworked stone, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is deep three-dimensional carved relief organised into clear stacked horizontal registers with volumetric, semi-naturalistic animals, while B is flat red pigment painting with no register structure and highly abstracted boat- or crescent-like forms, so the manner of making and overall composition are fundamentally different.
